checkDefaults.title: Check defaults
checkDefaults.description: What every keyword is checked with, unless it has its own setting.
checkDefaults.saveValidation: Check the highlighted settings before saving.
checkDefaults.saveError: Check defaults could not be saved.
checkDefaults.frequencyHelp: Frequency drives provider usage, not dashboard freshness.
checkDefaults.cronHelp: Five fields, standard syntax. Schedules must run at least one hour apart.
checkDefaults.timezoneHelp: Anchors all check schedules to the selected local clock.
checkDefaults.previewInvalid: Cron expression could not be parsed.
checkDefaults.previewAnchorsTooClose: Schedules must run at least one hour apart.
checkDefaults.previewReady: Each keyword is scheduled at or after an anchor using deterministic jitter.
checkDefaults.locationHelp: One project-wide default. Typing filters countries and available city locations.
checkDefaults.locationNoMatching: No matching locations. Try another name or select the country.
checkDefaults.deviceHelp: Desktop and mobile checks keep separate history.
checkDefaults.serpDepthHelp: How far down each result page a check reads.
checkDefaults.serpDepthWarning: From the next check, keywords ranking past {depth, number} record as not found instead of their position. That gap stays in history.
checkDefaults.stopOnMatch: Stop checks at first domain match
checkDefaults.stopOnMatchDescription: On stops reading when {domain} first appears, recording the best position. Off reads the full configured depth.

matchScope.title: Matching scope
matchScope.description: What a SERP result has to look like to count for this project.
matchScope.primaryDescription: Counts {domain} and www.{domain} across HTTP and HTTPS. Other subdomains stay separate.
matchScope.allSubdomainsDescription: Counts {domain}, www.{domain}, docs.{domain}, app.{domain}, blog.{domain}, and any other subdomain. HTTP/HTTPS and URL paths do not change the match.
matchScope.urlPrefixDescription: Only counts pages under a specific path, for example {domain}/docs/.
matchScope.noDomainDescription: Add the project domain in General to see which SERP results count as a match.
matchScope.roadmap: Matching is fixed per project today - changing it is on the roadmap.

searchSync.title: Search data sync
searchSync.description: Control historical Search Console import depth and import speed.
searchSync.historyClamped: This property's Google history starts {date} - deeper retention has nothing more to import.
searchSync.actionError: Search data sync action failed. Refresh the page and try again.
searchSync.pauseError: Search data sync could not be paused. Refresh the page and try again.
searchSync.resumeError: Search data sync could not be resumed. Refresh the page and try again.
searchSync.retryError: Search data sync could not be retried. Refresh the page and try again.
searchSync.saveValidation: Check the highlighted settings before saving.
searchSync.saveError: Search data sync settings could not be saved.
searchSync.preflightEstimate: Importing {months, number} months takes about {requests, number} requests to Google. First view in ~{firstViewMinutes, number} min; full history in ~{duration, number} {durationUnit, select, hours {hr} days {days} other {hr}} at {pace} speed.
searchSync.quota: This quota is shared with other tools using the same property.
searchSync.depthChange: Increasing depth extends the running import; decreasing depth keeps what is already imported.

control.quotaSupport: Google will resume the import automatically when its limit allows.
control.pausedSupport: Resume when you are ready to continue importing.
control.allPlannedRunning: All planned days are imported. Import is still running.
control.nextRequestIn: Next request in about {duration, number} {unit, select, seconds {sec} minutes {min} hours {hr} other {min}}.
control.waitingForDataSupport: Google has not reported finalized search data for this property yet.
control.delayedSupport: The active worker is unavailable or does not match this import.
control.statusUnavailableSupport: Current runtime facts are unavailable. Refresh to check again.
control.connectSupport: Reconnect Search Console to continue importing.
control.reconnectSupport: Reconnect Search Console to continue importing.
control.choosePropertySupport: Reconnect Search Console to continue importing.
control.askAdminToConnect: Ask a project admin to connect
control.pauseTooltip: Pausing longer than Google's 16-month window permanently loses the oldest unimported days.

inspection.title: URL inspection
inspection.description: Daily Search Console index-status checks for tracked target URLs.
inspection.help: Google allows 2,000 inspections per day per property, shared across every tool using it. bisibility caps this at 1,000 to leave room for other tools sharing the property quota. URLs over the limit wait for the next day.
inspection.saveValidation: Check the highlighted settings before saving.
inspection.saveError: URL inspection limit could not be saved.
